text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a review paper focusing broadly on fluvial flood modeling, hydrological and hydraulic modeling, rainfall modeling, climate change impacts, and land-use change impacts on flooding. While it discusses land-use change effects (notably urbanization and afforestation) on hydrology and flood risk, it does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation as a primary research question. The paper does not implement national-scale spatial LULC prediction, nor does it provide spatial modeling of LULC with quantitative accuracy metrics or mapped projections. It is a general review of flood modeling science and future research needs, with only limited discussion of land-use change impacts without LULC prediction modeling. Therefore, it does not meet inclusion criteria for LULC prediction-focused review or research.)
